Shaped iteration 0109 as one benchmark task in [tasks.json](tasks.json): draft a direct-LVPROJ writing-case proposal with an offline preparation checker.
[Independent review #541](history/sessions/541/76ff7a20024053285dc2a1d0dfb018249e33cc13017ebcdba5ad0828e1ad5afc.md) cleared the existing declaration evidence and confirmed that project-text writing lacks a case contract.
The task proposes one source-grounded instruction, allowed delta, preservation checks and separate missing-native statuses before independent review or real editing.
It also preserves #541's exact historical evidence with its published hash; completed probes are not repeated.
Assigned benchmark/default/high, 90 minutes and 70 turns, with no dependencies or overlapping writes.
No session can run LabVIEW; native validity, behavior and save-version preservation remain unverified.
POC follow-up remains deferred on its concrete edit-rule blockers; optional owner request #532 stays pending without blocking ready work.
Updated [working memory](../journal/working-memory.md) with the review outcome, evidence boundaries and cold-session instructions.
Startup diagnostics were healthy. Graph validation is by readback; this role has no shell.

## What next
Read the task's proposal, checker evidence and pins, then assign independent review before method integration or a real text trial.
Resume saved work if incomplete; avoid replaying #541, regenerating source inventory or treating preparation consistency as native success.
